texts.preamble: Mukesh Kumar Gupta vs Municipal Corporation Of Delhi And Ors on 10 October, 2023 Author: Siddharth Mridul Bench: Siddharth Mridul $~9 In The High Court Of Delhi At New Del + W.P.(C) 12827/2023 Mukesh Kumar Gupta Municipal Corporation Of Delhi And Ors. Advocates who appeared in this case:
texts.facts: The present writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, 1950, has been instituted on behalf of the petitioner, praying as follows:- Mukesh Kumar Gupta vs Municipal Corporation Of Delhi And Ors on 10 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86693459/ 1 "I. Pass an Order directing the respondents to allow the petitioner street vendor to peacefully vend in terms of vending Certificate issued by the Municipal Corporation of Delhi after conducting the survey of the petitioner. II. Pass an order directing the respondents to allow the petitioner street vendor to peacefully vend at his vending site i.e., On the Footpath, Mahatma Gandhi Road, Near Foot Over Bridge Escalator, ISBT Kashmere Gate, City-SP Zone, Ward-83-N, New Delhi without any Let or hindrance being caused by any public official. III. Pass an order directing the respondent no. 2 (TVC) to decide the representation dated 20.09.2023 sent by the petitioner for declaring him a Stationary Street Vendor by passing a speaking order. IV. Pass an order directing the respondent MCD to correct the nomenclature in the column for Type of Vendor from "Food/Snack with Gas Cylinder/fire" to "Stationary Street Vendor" (in view of the Section 6 of the Act) as detailed in the vending certificate issued to the petitioner. V. Pass an order for quashing and setting aside the terms of certificate of vending printed at the back side of the vending certificate to the extent which is not applicable to a stationary street vendor.
